Retouched vanilla style portraits and sprites to match. Includes hair fixes, clothing adjustments, and recoloring. 

Currently includes the bachelors and bachelorettes as well as a few side NPCs. Later versions to include all NPCs. 


Version 1.2.0: Now compatible with/reliant on Content Patcher. 

To install, use Nexus Mod Manager/Vortex or manually drop the mod folder into your "Mods" folder in the Stardew Valley game directory.
